requirements:
# Flexible Processing Control

- **Difficulty:** Hard (hard)

## Requirements

An automated production line consists of 5 workstations: numbered 1# to 5# from left to right. The 1# station is used for raw material loading, stations 2# to 4# are used for product processing, and the 5# station is used for finished product output and storage.
There is a motor in the production line, responsible for moving the product from one workstation to the next. Each workstation has a sensor (used to detect if the product has arrived).
Each product has a different sequence and number of processing steps, specified by the process sequence 'processSequence'. The processSequence is an array type, storing the sequence numbers of the workstations, and the system automatically sends the raw materials to the corresponding workstation for processing based on the station number.
Control requirements:
At the start of production, when the sensor at the 1# station (sensor1) detects the raw material, the start button at the 1# station (station1Start) is pressed. The system queries the first element of the process sequence 'processSequence', starts the conveyor to move the raw material to the corresponding workstation, and stops after delivery. Upon receiving the processing completion signal from the corresponding workstation (station2Complete to station4Complete), it continues to query the next element of the process sequence 'processSequence', determines the direction of the conveyor, and starts the conveyor (conveyorLeft, conveyorRight). This continues until the product is delivered to the 5# workstation.

processLength specifies the active sequence length, from 1 through 8, starting at processSequence[1]. The final active entry is output station 5; other active entries are processing stations 2 through 4. The caller supplies a sequence satisfying this contract.

## Interface Definition

| Direction | Variable/Field | Data Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Input | `processLength` | `USINT` | Active process-sequence length, 1..8; the final active entry must be station 5. |
| Input | `sensor1` | `BOOL` | Sensor at 1# station |
| Input | `sensor2` | `BOOL` | Sensor at 2# station |
| Input | `sensor3` | `BOOL` | Sensor at 3# station |
| Input | `sensor4` | `BOOL` | Sensor at 4# station |
| Input | `sensor5` | `BOOL` | Sensor at 5# station |
| Input | `station1Start` | `BOOL` | Start button at 1# station |
| Input | `station2Complete` | `BOOL` | Processing completion signal at 2# station |
| Input | `station3Complete` | `BOOL` | Processing completion signal at 3# station |
| Input | `station4Complete` | `BOOL` | Processing completion signal at 4# station |
| Input | `processSequence` | `ARRAY[1..8] OF USINT` | Processing sequence |
| Output | `conveyorLeft` | `BOOL` | Conveyor turns left |
| Output | `conveyorRight` | `BOOL` | Conveyor turns right |
scenario: A bidirectional conveyor follows a bounded sequence that may revisit processing stations.

interface.name: processLength
interface.description: Active process-sequence length, 1..8; the final active entry must be station 5.

scan_semantics: Inputs I[k] are sampled at invocation; outputs O[k] are observed after the call. Retained pre-state q[k] becomes q[k+1]. Each test resets the instance. A transition affects the same observed scan. dt_ms is elapsed time since the preceding invocation; the first invocation starts IEC timers at elapsed zero. CycleTime inputs, where supplied, are attributed to the current invocation rather than inferred from dt_ms.
safety_priority: Left and right are mutually exclusive.
Target arrival stops motion before accepting processing completion.
assumptions: The active sequence satisfies the official contract and remains fixed throughout a product cycle.
station1Start is a rising edge accepted with sensor1 while idle.
Destination arrival immediately stops the motor. Completion is accepted only at the current processing wait.
Completion signals are rising edges. Consecutive equal stations denote separate processing operations with fresh edges and no conveyor movement.
Only one sequence-index advancement occurs per invocation. Station5 arrival returns to idle.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.
Station completion edges are ignored unless post-entry phase is WAIT_PROCESS; dropping a station arrival sensor while already in WAIT_PROCESS is outside caller error injection.

atomic_propositions.higher: post-phase MOVING AND targetStation>currentStation AND NOT sensor[targetStation]
atomic_propositions.lower: post-phase MOVING AND targetStation<currentStation AND NOT sensor[targetStation]
atomic_propositions.waiting: pre-phase WAIT_PROCESS AND no fresh completion edge
atomic_propositions.out: pre-phase MOVING AND targetStation=5 AND sensor5
atomic_propositions.done: post phase IDLE after station5 arrival
atomic_propositions.completion: fresh matching processing-complete edge in the current wait
atomic_propositions.started: station1Start rising edge accepted with sensor1 in idle

令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB016(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
活动路线长度1..8，前项为2/3/4且末项5，活动周期内固定。初始IDLE、station=1、index=0。IDLE在station1Start上升沿且sensor1时选择首目标；MOVING到目标后进入WAIT_PROCESS或目标5回IDLE；WAIT_PROCESS仅对应完成新边沿推进index，同站继续等待。输出仅转移后MOVING且未到目标时按target与station方向开启；所有边沿历史逐拍更新。
atomic_propositions.conveyorLeft: O[k].conveyorLeft: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.conveyorRight: O[k].conveyorRight: independently observed post-scan candidate value (BOOL); never defined as expected output.
atomic_propositions.station1Start_rejected: pre-phase IDLE AND station1Start AND NOT sensor1
atomic_propositions.init: At the separate pre-invocation initial observation before scan k=0: Spre.phase="IDLE", O_init.conveyorLeft=false, O_init.conveyorRight=false.

ltl.description: Before the first scan invocation, all declared OUTPUT variables and initial instance state hold their declared initial values.
ltl.explanation: Applies strictly to the fresh pre-invocation initial instance observation before scan k=0 (INITIAL_INSTANCE scope).

ltl.name: Interlock
ltl.explanation: Both directions can never run together.

ltl.name: Direction
ltl.explanation: The target/current station order determines direction.

ltl.name: Wait
ltl.explanation: A processing wait does not move without completion.

ltl.name: Output
ltl.explanation: The final station completes the sequence.

ltl.name: Conditional completion
ltl.formula: (G(moving -> F arrive) & G(processing -> F completion)) -> G(started -> F done)
ltl.explanation: Under the valid fixed-sequence input contract, eventual external feedback permits every started route to complete.

ltl.description: Pressing station1Start in IDLE when sensor1 is FALSE keeps both conveyor motors OFF.
ltl.explanation: Forbids starting automatic transport without a detected product at station 1.

Every constrained ACTUAL output satisfies the exact pinned input-driven reference transition and comparison policy. Finite observations can falsify this predicate; no completed unbounded proof is claimed.

specification_contract.observation: I[k] is sampled before execution; O[k] is observed after execution. Initial conditions apply before invocation zero.
specification_contract.normative_completion:
令(Sref[k+1], E[k])=T_PUB016(Sref[k], deepCopy(I[k]), dt_ms[k])。T由normalized_specification.transition列出的固定Python源码和初始状态精确定义。CompleteBehavior[k] 当且仅当所有constrained_observed_fields均存在于实际O[k]，且分别满足comparison关系。Sref只由采样输入推进，绝不由O或候选内部变量推进。
活动路线长度1..8，前项为2/3/4且末项5，活动周期内固定。初始IDLE、station=1、index=0。IDLE在station1Start上升沿且sensor1时选择首目标；MOVING到目标后进入WAIT_PROCESS或目标5回IDLE；WAIT_PROCESS仅对应完成新边沿推进index，同站继续等待。输出仅转移后MOVING且未到目标时按target与station方向开启；所有边沿历史逐拍更新。
specification_contract.history_binding: I, O and Sref namespaces, initialization and updates are defined in normalized_specification.observation, history_bindings and reference_state_initial. Candidate output never drives Sref.
specification_contract.evaluation_scope: Versioned executable scan predicate plus LTL over interpreted predicates. No native checker encoding or completed formal proof is claimed.
specification_contract.transition_binding: Use normalized_specification.transition and exact pinned source snapshots.

normalized_specification.language: LTL over typed scan predicates; finite conjunction is a binding-time macro, not native NuSMV syntax.

transition.reference_binding: Persistent plc_agent.scan_contract.ScanContract('PUB016'); constructed once per independent case, current state is Sref[k].
transition.state_update: Exactly once per scan; mutations of sampled IN_OUT copies are reference effects, not observations.
transition.hash_encoding: UTF-8 without BOM; all line endings normalized to LF before SHA256

comparison.integer_boolean: exact type and value; no tolerance
comparison.float: finite; abs error<=1e-5; dictionary/list shape and non-float values exact
comparison.PUB008: only successfully converted channels[j].outputValue: abs<=1e-5 OR rel<=2e-6; all preserved/config fields exact
comparison.PUB017: Successful deletion constrains recipeID=0; other fields of that deleted slot are unconstrained for the deletion scan. Subsequent no-write scans preserve the sampled actual representation. This observer history is separate from the logical reference database.
comparison.TIME_LTIME: exact integer nanoseconds after IEC literal parsing
comparison.implementation: plc_agent.normalized_spec.NormalizedScanMonitor.step with output_matches (pinned sources); observer histories never drive the independent logical reference

observation.I[k]: deep-copied inputs immediately before invocation k
observation.O[k]: actual outputs immediately after invocation k, supplied by independent execution backend
observation.Sref[k]: independent reference state BEFORE k; unrelated to similarly named candidate variables
observation.initial: fresh instance BEFORE invocation 0; never substituted by O[0]
observation.X: next scan-sequence position; argument must be Boolean, not a numeric term
observation.time: dt_ms is observed elapsed time; public timers use physical time, SELF Tick/count timers use logical scans

auxiliary_state_bindings.Spre: Sref[k], before the invocation; initialized by reference_state_initial
auxiliary_state_bindings.Spost: Sref[k+1], after exactly one pinned transition on I[k]
auxiliary_state_bindings.first: k=0 (first invocation); distinct from the pre-invocation initial observation
auxiliary_state_bindings.pre-output: actual O[k-1] for OUTPUT (explicit history initial where declared); I[k] for caller-owned IN_OUT
auxiliary_state_bindings.previous-input: I[k-1] for k>=1; edge memory for BOOL requests initially FALSE and updated after EVERY invocation
auxiliary_state_bindings.reference_warning: Spre/Spost predicates are input-driven ghosts, not evidence that candidate internals match. Conclusions about the candidate must constrain actual O.

normalized_specification.reference_state_rule: Initial state is the serialized constructor above; all fields update solely through the pinned transition. Ghost phase/history/queue are names for this state, not observed candidate state.

primitives.bitwise: DWORD AND/NOT and popcount operate on unsigned 32-bit values; complement is masked by 0xFFFFFFFF.
primitives.time_literals: IEC TIME/LTIME literals are exact integer durations in nanoseconds.
primitives.observed_arrays: All IN_OUT inputs are snapshots before invocation; outputs are independently acquired after invocation. Physical bounds map by ordinal, never share another array lower bound.
primitives.boolean_next: X takes a Boolean formula. Numeric history transport is bit-expanded for DWORD; Boolean histories use equivalence.
primitives.time_progress: Timed eventuality clauses explicitly require G(F(TimeTick)); TimeTick denotes crossing a new integer-ms boundary. Finite observations cannot establish this premise.

assumptions: The active sequence satisfies the official contract and remains fixed throughout a product cycle.
station1Start is a rising edge accepted with sensor1 while idle.
Destination arrival immediately stops the motor. Completion is accepted only at the current processing wait.
Completion signals are rising edges. Consecutive equal stations denote separate processing operations with fresh edges and no conveyor movement.
Only one sequence-index advancement occurs per invocation. Station5 arrival returns to idle.

The task interface, requirements, assumptions, and normalized LTL definitions (excluding reference-only ground truth) are supplied identically to both frameworks. Output names always denote observed candidate outputs, never precomputed expected values.
Station completion edges are ignored unless post-entry phase is WAIT_PROCESS; dropping a station arrival sensor while already in WAIT_PROCESS is outside caller error injection.

normalized_specification.domain_policy: Declared interface types and task assumptions apply. The pinned transition defines numeric/timing domains and rejects unsupported inputs. Reference exceptions are DOMAIN_OR_TOOL_ERROR, never candidate FAIL or PASS. Fairness/time-divergence assumptions concern infinite paths and are not proven by finite observations.
limitations: No ST-to-model translation or infinite-trace proof is implemented here.
Focused legacy LTL predicates still require backend lowering; normalization is not model-checker acceptance.
Finite matching cannot establish liveness or validate runtime provenance.
normalized_specification.rules_zh: 活动路线长度1..8，前项为2/3/4且末项5，活动周期内固定。初始IDLE、station=1、index=0。IDLE在station1Start上升沿且sensor1时选择首目标；MOVING到目标后进入WAIT_PROCESS或目标5回IDLE；WAIT_PROCESS仅对应完成新边沿推进index，同站继续等待。输出仅转移后MOVING且未到目标时按target与station方向开启；所有边沿历史逐拍更新。
